+# AGENTS — fiscal-tenant-catalog-20261101
+
+- Preparation only: never apply install/rollback hosted, publish, grant or flip gates from this package; the owner/auditor reviews and applies — prevents unreviewed fiscal writers.
+- Depends on the uninstalled tenant catalog ownership package (scripts/rbac-audit/proposed-tenant-catalog-ownership*.sql); PRE aborts if `produtos.owner_organization_id` or `catalog_ownership_enabled()` is absent — never inline or fork that foundation.
+- Reuse `product_fiscal_profiles` (one active profile per product); owned-item tenant is always the product's immutable owner, never a payload/GUC/claim value — single fiscal source.
+- Owned writes only through `tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save` (DEFINER, fixed search_path, actor+tenant+role re-check after lock, CAS by `updated_at`, idempotent receipt); RESTRICTIVE policies keep direct client writes to global rows only and hide other tenants' owned rows — prevents cross-tenant reads/writes and Superadmin writes on tenant items.
+- New profiles start DRAFT; the RPC never sets VALIDATED nor infers NCM/CFOP — classification comes from accounting.
+- Own gate `owned_fiscal_gate` starts disabled; rollback is deny-only (gate false + revoke EXECUTE), never drops policies or receipts.
+- Global fertilizer creation reuses `platform_create_global_product` + `platform_set_global_product_family`; no SQL here — fertilizer `tipo`/unit remain an owner decision.
+- Local tests use disposable PostgreSQL with synthetic auth stubs; never report them as hosted JWT/RLS proof.

+-- fiscal-tenant-catalog-20261101 — CANDIDATO INATIVO. NÃO APLICAR sem revisão/autorização.
+-- Pré-requisito: pacote de propriedade do catálogo (owner_organization_id) já instalado.
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s';
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- PRE (fail-closed)
+DO $pre$ BEGIN
+  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public'
+       AND table_name='produtos' AND column_name='owner_organization_id') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: catalog ownership not installed (produtos.owner_organization_id)'; END IF;
+  IF to_regprocedure('platform_private.catalog_ownership_enabled()') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('platform_private.h15_actor_organization()') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('platform_private.has_role(uuid,public.app_role)') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(uuid)') IS NULL
+     OR to_regprocedure('platform_private.catalog_reader_org()') IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: required helpers missing'; END IF;
+  IF to_regclass('platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate') IS NOT NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: package already installed (rerun refused)'; END IF;
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='product_fiscal_profiles') <> 4 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRE: product_fiscal_profiles policy drift'; END IF;
+END $pre$;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- gate próprio (desligado)
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate (
+  singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK (singleton),
+  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
+);
+INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate VALUES (true, false);
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled() RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+  SELECT platform_private.catalog_ownership_enabled()
+     AND COALESCE((SELECT enabled FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate WHERE singleton), false) $$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- Ator de empresa: retorna a empresa ativa do ator real com papel exigido; nunca SA.
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(p_write boolean) RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  IF v_uid IS NULL OR NOT platform_private.owned_fiscal_enabled()
+     OR public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid)
+     OR NOT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(v_uid) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  v_org := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
+  IF v_org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  IF NOT (platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'administrador') OR platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro')
+          OR (NOT p_write AND platform_private.has_role(v_uid,'gestor'))) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  RETURN v_org;
+END $$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(boolean) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- recibos idempotentes (privados)
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts (
+  idempotency_key uuid PRIMARY KEY,
+  actor_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, product_id uuid NOT NULL,
+  request jsonb NOT NULL, receipt jsonb NOT NULL,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+REVOKE ALL ON platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- RLS restritiva
+-- Leitura: global para quem já lê; próprio só da empresa do leitor.
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_owner_read ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id
+    AND (p.owner_organization_id IS NULL OR p.owner_organization_id = platform_private.catalog_reader_org())));
+-- Escrita direta: somente perfis de produtos GLOBAIS (Superadmin pelas policies existentes).
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_global_insert ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL));
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_global_update ON public.product_fiscal_profiles AS RESTRICTIVE
+  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
+  USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL))
+  WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=product_id AND p.owner_organization_id IS NULL));
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- validação de valores
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(p jsonb) RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE k text;
+  v_allowed constant text[] := ARRAY['ncm','cest','cfop_in_state','cfop_interstate','origin_code','icms_cst','icms_csosn',
+    'ipi_cst','pis_cst','cofins_cst','commercial_unit','taxable_unit','gtin','taxable_gtin','tax_benefit_code',
+    'fiscal_description','accounting_notes'];
+BEGIN
+  IF p IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p) <> 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  FOR k IN SELECT jsonb_object_keys(p) LOOP
+    IF NOT k = ANY(v_allowed) OR jsonb_typeof(p->k) NOT IN ('string','null')
+       OR char_length(p->>k) > 2000 THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF (p->>'ncm') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'ncm') !~ '^[0-9]{8}$'
+     OR (p->>'cest') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cest') !~ '^[0-9]{7}$'
+     OR (p->>'cfop_in_state') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cfop_in_state') !~ '^[1-7][0-9]{3}$'
+     OR (p->>'cfop_interstate') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'cfop_interstate') !~ '^[1-7][0-9]{3}$'
+     OR (p->>'origin_code') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'origin_code') !~ '^[0-8]$'
+     OR (p->>'gtin') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'gtin') !~ '^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$'
+     OR (p->>'taxable_gtin') IS NOT NULL AND (p->>'taxable_gtin') !~ '^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+END $$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(jsonb) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- writer canônico
+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(p_product_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamptz,
+  p_values jsonb, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key uuid) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_owner uuid; v_prof public.product_fiscal_profiles%ROWTYPE;
+  v_req jsonb; v_old platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts%ROWTYPE; v_receipt jsonb; v_v jsonb;
+BEGIN
+  v_org := platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true);
+  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL OR p_reason IS NULL
+     OR char_length(btrim(p_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 500 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  PERFORM platform_private.owned_fiscal_validate(p_values);
+  v_v := jsonb_strip_nulls(p_values) || '{}'::jsonb;
+  v_req := jsonb_build_object('product_id',p_product_id,'expected',p_expected_updated_at,'values',p_values,'reason',btrim(p_reason));
+
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('owned-fiscal:'||p_idempotency_key::text,0));
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  SELECT * INTO v_old FROM platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts WHERE idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF v_old.actor_id<>v_uid OR v_old.organization_id<>v_org OR v_old.request IS DISTINCT FROM v_req THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_key_conflict' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    RETURN v_old.receipt || '{"idempotent":true}'::jsonb;
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT owner_organization_id INTO v_owner FROM public.produtos WHERE id=p_product_id FOR SHARE;
+  IF NOT FOUND OR v_owner IS NULL OR v_owner<>v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('owned-fiscal-product:'||p_product_id::text,0));
+  IF platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(true) IS DISTINCT FROM v_org THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
+
+  SELECT * INTO v_prof FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles
+   WHERE product_id=p_product_id AND is_active IS TRUE FOR UPDATE;
+  IF FOUND THEN
+    IF p_expected_updated_at IS NULL OR v_prof.updated_at IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    UPDATE public.product_fiscal_profiles SET
+      ncm=p_values->>'ncm', cest=p_values->>'cest', cfop_in_state=p_values->>'cfop_in_state',
+      cfop_interstate=p_values->>'cfop_interstate', origin_code=p_values->>'origin_code',
+      icms_cst=p_values->>'icms_cst', icms_csosn=p_values->>'icms_csosn', ipi_cst=p_values->>'ipi_cst',
+      pis_cst=p_values->>'pis_cst', cofins_cst=p_values->>'cofins_cst', commercial_unit=p_values->>'commercial_unit',
+      taxable_unit=p_values->>'taxable_unit', gtin=p_values->>'gtin', taxable_gtin=p_values->>'taxable_gtin',
+      tax_benefit_code=p_values->>'tax_benefit_code', fiscal_description=p_values->>'fiscal_description',
+      accounting_notes=p_values->>'accounting_notes',
+      -- edição reabre revisão contábil; nunca promove para VALIDATED
+      profile_status=CASE WHEN v_prof.profile_status='BLOCKED' THEN 'BLOCKED' ELSE 'DRAFT' END,
+      accounting_validated_at=NULL, accounting_validated_by=NULL,
+      updated_at=clock_timestamp(), updated_by=v_uid
+    WHERE id=v_prof.id RETURNING * INTO v_prof;
+  ELSE
+    IF p_expected_updated_at IS NOT NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_stale' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
+    INSERT INTO public.product_fiscal_profiles (product_id,is_active,profile_status,ncm,cest,cfop_in_state,cfop_interstate,
+      origin_code,icms_cst,icms_csosn,ipi_cst,pis_cst,cofins_cst,commercial_unit,taxable_unit,gtin,taxable_gtin,
+      tax_benefit_code,fiscal_description,accounting_notes,created_by,updated_by)
+    VALUES (p_product_id,true,'DRAFT',p_values->>'ncm',p_values->>'cest',p_values->>'cfop_in_state',p_values->>'cfop_interstate',
+      p_values->>'origin_code',p_values->>'icms_cst',p_values->>'icms_csosn',p_values->>'ipi_cst',p_values->>'pis_cst',
+      p_values->>'cofins_cst',p_values->>'commercial_unit',p_values->>'taxable_unit',p_values->>'gtin',p_values->>'taxable_gtin',
+      p_values->>'tax_benefit_code',p_values->>'fiscal_description',p_values->>'accounting_notes',v_uid,v_uid)
+    RETURNING * INTO v_prof;
+  END IF;
+
+  v_receipt := jsonb_build_object('success',true,'product_id',p_product_id,'profile_id',v_prof.id,
+    'organization_id',v_org,'profile_status',v_prof.profile_status,'updated_at',v_prof.updated_at,
+    'idempotency_key',p_idempotency_key,'idempotent',false);
+  INSERT INTO platform_private.owned_fiscal_receipts VALUES (p_idempotency_key,v_uid,v_org,p_product_id,v_req,v_receipt,now());
+  RETURN v_receipt;
+END $$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamptz,jsonb,text,uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;

+CREATE FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(p_limit integer, p_offset integer) RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v_org uuid;
+BEGIN
+  v_org := platform_private.owned_fiscal_actor(false);
+  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset < 0 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owned_fiscal_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
+  RETURN jsonb_build_object('organization_id',v_org,
+    'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.produtos WHERE owner_organization_id=v_org),
+    'items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(r ORDER BY r->>'nome', r->>'product_id') FROM (
+      SELECT jsonb_build_object('product_id',p.id,'nome',p.nome,'codigo',p.codigo,'familia',p.familia_catalogo,
+        'profile', (SELECT to_jsonb(f) - ARRAY['created_by','updated_by','accounting_validated_by']
+                      FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles f WHERE f.product_id=p.id AND f.is_active IS TRUE)) r
+      FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.owner_organization_id=v_org
+      ORDER BY p.nome, p.id LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset) s),'[]'::jsonb));
+END $$;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(integer,integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+
+COMMIT;

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# PostgreSQL descartável local. Remove todas as variáveis PG* para nunca tocar banco hosted.
+set -u
+for v in $(compgen -e | grep '^PG'); do unset "$v"; done
+cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
+D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pgfiscal.XXXX); PORT=55437
+AS=""; if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then chown 1000:1000 "$D"; AS="setpriv --reuid=1000 --regid=1000 --clear-groups"; fi
+$AS initdb -D "$D/data" -U postgres -A trust >/dev/null
+$AS pg_ctl -D "$D/data" -o "-p $PORT -k $D -c listen_addresses=''" -l "$D/log" -w start >/dev/null
+P="psql -X -h $D -p $PORT -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1"
+echo "== PRE sem fundação de propriedade (deve abortar)"
+$P -q -c "CREATE TABLE public.produtos(id uuid);" && $P -f install.sql.review 2>&1 | grep -E "PRE:|ERROR" | head -2
+$P -q -c "DROP TABLE public.produtos;"
+echo "== stub + install"
+$P -q -f test/stub-schema.sql && $P -q -f install.sql.review && echo "install OK"
+echo "== reinstalação (deve recusar)"
+$P -f install.sql.review 2>&1 | grep -E "PRE:" | head -1
+echo "== testes"
+$P -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 -f test/tests.sql
+$AS pg_ctl -D "$D/data" -m fast stop >/dev/null; rm -rf "$D"

+-- Esquema REDUZIDO e Auth SINTÉTICA para PostgreSQL descartável. Não é prova hosted.
+CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN; CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN;
+CREATE SCHEMA auth; CREATE SCHEMA platform_private;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, auth TO authenticated, anon;
+CREATE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$ SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('test.uid',true),'')::uuid $$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION auth.uid() TO authenticated, anon;
+CREATE TYPE public.app_role AS ENUM ('administrador','gestor','financeiro','tecnico_agronomo','superadmin');
+CREATE TABLE public.organizations (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, ativo boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ativa');
+CREATE TABLE public.profiles (user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, organization_id uuid, ativo boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, senha_provisoria boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false);
+CREATE TABLE public.user_roles (user_id uuid, role public.app_role);
+CREATE TABLE platform_private.test_gate (enabled boolean);
+INSERT INTO platform_private.test_gate VALUES (true);
+CREATE FUNCTION public.is_platform_superadmin(u uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS
+ $$ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=u AND role='superadmin') $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS
+ $$ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id=p_user AND p.ativo AND NOT p.senha_provisoria) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role public.app_role) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS
+ $$ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id=r.user_id WHERE r.user_id=_user_id AND r.role=_role AND p.ativo AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id)) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.h15_actor_organization() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS
+ $$ SELECT p.organization_id FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id AND o.ativo WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_ownership_enabled() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS
+ $$ SELECT enabled FROM platform_private.test_gate $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_reader_org() RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $$
+DECLARE v uuid; BEGIN
+  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid()) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  v := platform_private.h15_actor_organization(); RETURN v; END $$;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA platform_private TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_reader_org() TO authenticated;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.global_product_fiscal_read_ready() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS
+ $$ SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid()) OR platform_private.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR platform_private.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor') OR platform_private.has_role(auth.uid(),'financeiro')) $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION platform_private.global_product_fiscal_write_ready() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS
+ $$ SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND public.is_platform_superadmin(auth.uid()) $$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA platform_private TO authenticated;
+CREATE TABLE public.produtos (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, nome text NOT NULL, codigo text, familia_catalogo text,
+  owner_organization_id uuid REFERENCES public.organizations(id));
+CREATE TABLE public.product_fiscal_profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), product_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.produtos(id),
+  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, fiscal_description text, commercial_unit text, taxable_unit text, ncm text, cest text,
+  origin_code text, cfop_in_state text, cfop_interstate text, icms_cst text, icms_csosn text, pis_cst text, cofins_cst text, ipi_cst text,
+  gtin text, taxable_gtin text, tax_benefit_code text, approximate_tax_source text, profile_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
+  accounting_notes text, accounting_validated_at timestamptz, accounting_validated_by uuid,
+  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), created_by uuid, updated_by uuid);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON public.product_fiscal_profiles(product_id) WHERE is_active;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON public.product_fiscal_profiles TO authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.produtos TO authenticated;
+ALTER TABLE public.product_fiscal_profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+-- Réplica das 4 policies LIVE (lidas 01/11 read-only).
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_delete ON public.product_fiscal_profiles FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (false);
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_insert ON public.product_fiscal_profiles FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (platform_private.global_product_fiscal_write_ready());
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_read ON public.product_fiscal_profiles FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (platform_private.global_product_fiscal_read_ready());
+CREATE POLICY product_fiscal_profiles_update ON public.product_fiscal_profiles FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (platform_private.global_product_fiscal_write_ready()) WITH CHECK (platform_private.global_product_fiscal_write_ready());

+-- Asserções em PG descartável. Cada caso imprime PASS/FAIL. Auth sintética via test.uid.
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP 0
+CREATE TEMP TABLE r(n serial, name text, ok boolean, detail text);
+GRANT ALL ON r TO authenticated, anon; GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE r_n_seq TO authenticated, anon;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect_err(p_name text, p_sql text, p_state text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+BEGIN
+  BEGIN EXECUTE p_sql;
+    INSERT INTO r(name,ok,detail) VALUES (p_name,false,'no error');
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    INSERT INTO r(name,ok,detail) VALUES (p_name, SQLSTATE=p_state, SQLSTATE||' '||SQLERRM);
+  END;
+END $$;
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect_ok(p_name text, p_sql text, p_check text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
+DECLARE v boolean;
+BEGIN
+  BEGIN EXECUTE p_sql; EXECUTE p_check INTO v;
+    INSERT INTO r(name,ok,detail) VALUES (p_name, coalesce(v,false), 'check='||coalesce(v::text,'null'));
+  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+    INSERT INTO r(name,ok,detail) VALUES (p_name,false,SQLSTATE||' '||SQLERRM);
+  END;
+END $$;
+
+-- Etapa de GRANT simulada (no hosted só em etapa separada autorizada).
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save(uuid,timestamptz,jsonb,text,uuid), public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_list(integer,integer) TO authenticated;
+-- 0. gate fechado por padrão: admin A negado
+SET test.uid='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'; SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT pg_temp.expect_err('gate_off_denies', $q$SELECT public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',NULL,'{"ncm":"31010000"}','motivo de teste ok','90000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')$q$,'42501');
+RESET ROLE; UPDATE platform_private.owned_fiscal_gate SET enabled=true; SET ROLE authenticated;
+
+-- 1. admin A cria perfil DRAFT do próprio item
+SELECT pg_temp.expect_ok('admin_A_creates_own', $q$SELECT public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',NULL,'{"ncm":"31010000","cfop_in_state":"5101"}','motivo de teste ok','90000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002')$q$,
+  $c$SELECT profile_status='DRAFT' AND ncm='31010000' FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles WHERE product_id='d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a'$c$);
+-- 2. replay mesma chave/payload: idempotente, sem duplicar
+SELECT pg_temp.expect_ok('replay_same_key', $q$SELECT 1$q$,
+  $c$SELECT (public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',NULL,'{"ncm":"31010000","cfop_in_state":"5101"}','motivo de teste ok','90000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002')->>'idempotent')::boolean
+     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles WHERE product_id='d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a')=1$c$);
+-- 3. mesma chave, payload diferente: conflito
+SELECT pg_temp.expect_err('same_key_other_payload', $q$SELECT public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',NULL,'{"ncm":"31010001"}','motivo de teste ok','90000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002')$q$,'PT409');
+-- 4. CAS: sem expected em perfil existente = stale
+SELECT pg_temp.expect_err('cas_missing_expected', $q$SELECT public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',NULL,'{"ncm":"31010001"}','motivo de teste ok','90000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003')$q$,'PT409');
+SELECT pg_temp.expect_err('cas_wrong_expected', $q$SELECT public.tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save('d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a','2000-01-01','{"ncm":"31010001"}','motivo de teste ok','90000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004')$q$,'PT409');
+-- 5. CAS correto atualiza e mantém DRAFT

+  $c$SELECT ncm='31010001' AND profile_status='DRAFT' AND cfop_in_state IS NULL FROM public.product_fiscal_profiles WHERE product_id='d0000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a'$c$);

+/**
+ * Fase Fiscal 3.2 — Hooks tipados para `product_fiscal_profiles`.
+ *
+ * - Sem `any`, sem casts amplos.
+ * - `.select(...)` seleciona SOMENTE colunas necessárias.
+ * - Paginação server-side via `.range()`.
+ * - Mutações separadas (create/update) — não usamos upsert porque a
+ *   unicidade `product_id` não é garantida pelo contrato exposto em
+ *   `types.ts` nesta fase.
+ * - Concorrência otimista no UPDATE via `updated_at` prévio.
+ * - Erro de RLS/permissão nunca se torna sucesso silencioso.
+ */
+import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
+import { useScopedPortalQuery } from "@/hooks/useScopedPortalQuery";
+import { useProductFiscalAccess } from "@/hooks/useProductFiscalAccess";
+import { supabase } from "@/integrations/supabase/client";
+import type { Database } from "@/integrations/supabase/cultivofarm.types";
+import {
+  buildInsertPayload,
+  buildUpdatePayload,
+  productFiscalFormSchema,
+  type ProductFiscalFormValues,
+  type ProductFiscalRow,
+} from "@/lib/fiscal/productFiscalValidation";
+import {
+  PRODUCT_FISCAL_PROFILE_STATUSES,
+  isProductFiscalProfileStatus,
+} from "@/lib/fiscal/fiscalOptions";
+
+export type ReadinessRow = any;
+
+// Resource prefixes only: useScopedPortalQuery appends canonical actor and
+// request scopes (actor/tenant/roles/epoch). Never use these prefixes for raw reads.
+export const PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS = {
+  root: ["fiscal", "product-profiles"] as const,
+  list: (p: ListParams) =>
+    [...PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.root, "list", p] as const,
+  readiness: (ids: string[]) =>
+    [...PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.root, "readiness", ids.slice().sort()] as const,
+  byIds: (ids: string[]) =>
+    [...PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.root, "by-ids", ids.slice().sort()] as const,
+};
+
+export interface ListParams {
+  search: string;
+  status: string | null;
+  page: number;
+  pageSize: number;
+  /** Família comercial canônica (`produtos.familia_catalogo`); null = todas. */
+  familia?: string | null;
+}
+
+export interface ProductListItem {
+  product_id: string;
+  product_nome: string;
+  product_codigo: string | null;
+  profile_id: string | null;
+  profile_status: string | null;
+  is_active: boolean | null;
+  ncm: string | null;
+  cest: string | null;
+  cfop_in_state: string | null;
+  cfop_interstate: string | null;
+  updated_at: string | null;
+  familia: string | null;
+}
+
+export interface ListResult {
+  items: ProductListItem[];
+  total: number;
+  statuses: string[];
+}
+
+function isPermissionError(err: unknown): boolean {
+  if (!err || typeof err !== "object") return false;
+  const e = err as { code?: string; status?: number; message?: string };
+  if (e.code === "42501" || e.code === "PGRST301") return true;
+  if (e.status === 401 || e.status === 403) return true;
+  if (typeof e.message === "string" && /permission|denied|rls/i.test(e.message))
+    return true;
+  return false;
+}

+/**
+ * Lista dirigida pela tabela `produtos` (fonte de verdade do catálogo) com
+ * join left para `product_fiscal_profiles`. Assim exibimos produtos sem
+ * perfil e produtos com perfil, sem alterar o cadastro mestre.
+ */
+export function useProductFiscalList(
+  params: ListParams,
+  options: { enabled?: boolean } = {},
+) {
+  const request = useProductFiscalAccess("product-fiscal-read");
+  const actor = useProductFiscalAccess("portal-query-actor");
+  const enabled = options.enabled ?? true;
+  const result = useScopedPortalQuery<ListResult>({
+    queryKey: PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.list(params),
+    enabled,
+    queryFn: async () => {
+      const from = params.page * params.pageSize;
+      const to = from + params.pageSize - 1;
+
+      const term = params.search.trim();
+      const safeTerm = term.replace(/[,()]/g, " ").slice(0, 100);
+      // Status entra ANTES do range: quando definido, usamos !inner para que
+      // o count e os items reflitam exatamente o subconjunto filtrado.
+      // Ramos separados por variante (evita união de tipos do query builder).
+      const hasStatus =
+        !!params.status && isProductFiscalProfileStatus(params.status);
+
+      const runFiltered = async () => {
+        let q = (supabase as any)
+          .from("produtos")
+          .select(
+            "id, nome, codigo, familia_catalogo, product_fiscal_profiles!inner(id, profile_status, is_active, ncm, cest, cfop_in_state, cfop_interstate, updated_at)",
+            { count: "exact" },
+          )
+          .eq("product_fiscal_profiles.is_active", true)
+          .eq("product_fiscal_profiles.profile_status", params.status as string)
+          .eq("product_fiscal_profiles.is_active", true)
+          .order("nome", { ascending: true })
+          .range(from, to);
+        if (safeTerm) {
+          q = q.or(`nome.ilike.%${safeTerm}%,codigo.ilike.%${safeTerm}%`);
+        }
+        if (params.familia) q = q.eq("familia_catalogo", params.familia);
+        return q;
+      };
+
+      const runUnfiltered = async () => {
+        let q = (supabase as any)
+          .from("produtos")
+          .select(
+            "id, nome, codigo, familia_catalogo, product_fiscal_profiles(id, profile_status, is_active, ncm, cest, cfop_in_state, cfop_interstate, updated_at)",
+            { count: "exact" },
+          )
+          .eq("product_fiscal_profiles.is_active", true)
+          .order("nome", { ascending: true })
+          .range(from, to);
+        if (safeTerm) {
+          q = q.or(`nome.ilike.%${safeTerm}%,codigo.ilike.%${safeTerm}%`);
+        }
+        if (params.familia) q = q.eq("familia_catalogo", params.familia);
+        return q;
+      };
+
+      const { data, error, count } = hasStatus
+        ? await runFiltered()
+        : await runUnfiltered();
+      if (error) {
+        if (isPermissionError(error)) throw new Error("permission_denied");
+        throw new Error(error.message);
+      }
+
+      const items: ProductListItem[] = (data ?? []).map((p: any) => {
+        const profileRaw = p.product_fiscal_profiles;
+        const profile = Array.isArray(profileRaw)
+          ? profileRaw[0] ?? null
+          : profileRaw ?? null;
+        return {
+          product_id: p.id,
+          product_nome: p.nome,
+          product_codigo: p.codigo ?? null,
+          profile_id: profile?.id ?? null,
+          profile_status: profile?.profile_status ?? null,
+          is_active: profile?.is_active ?? null,
+          ncm: profile?.ncm ?? null,
+          cest: profile?.cest ?? null,
+          cfop_in_state: profile?.cfop_in_state ?? null,
+          cfop_interstate: profile?.cfop_interstate ?? null,
+          updated_at: profile?.updated_at ?? null,
+          familia: p.familia_catalogo ?? null,
+        };
+      });
+
+      // Opções derivadas da lista canônica tipada (não da página).
+      const statuses = [...PRODUCT_FISCAL_PROFILE_STATUSES];
+
+      return { items, total: count ?? items.length, statuses };
+    },
+  }, { request, actor });
+  return { ...result, data: result.ready && !result.isError ? result.data : undefined };
+}

+/** Resumo agregado da view `v_product_fiscal_readiness` para os produtos da página. */
+export function useProductFiscalReadiness(
+  productIds: string[],
+  options: { enabled?: boolean } = {},
+) {
+  const request = useProductFiscalAccess("product-fiscal-read");
+  const actor = useProductFiscalAccess("portal-query-actor");
+  const enabled = (options.enabled ?? true) && productIds.length > 0;
+  const result = useScopedPortalQuery<ReadinessRow[]>({
+    queryKey: PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.readiness(productIds),
+    enabled,
+    queryFn: async () => {
+      const { data, error } = await (supabase as any)
+        .from("v_product_fiscal_readiness")
+        .select("product_id, profile_status, minimally_classified, accounting_validated")
+        .in("product_id", productIds as any);
+      if (error) {
+        if (isPermissionError(error)) throw new Error("permission_denied");
+        throw new Error(error.message);
+      }
+      return data ?? [];
+    },
+  }, { request, actor });
+  return { ...result, data: result.ready && !result.isError ? result.data : undefined };
+}

+/**
+ * Fase Fiscal 3.20.1 — Fonte independente para resolver produtos canônicos
+ * por ID, sem depender da página/filtro corrente de `useProductFiscalList`.
+ *
+ * Motivação: microrganismos podem apontar para produtos que não estão na
+ * página atual (ou que estão fora do filtro "Produtos"). Sem esta consulta,
+ * o vínculo seria falsamente exibido como "não associado". Buscamos apenas
+ * pelos IDs recebidos (dataset pequeno, N ≤ dezenas), com o MESMO join a
+ * `product_fiscal_profiles` para reutilizar o mesmo perfil canônico —
+ * nenhum perfil paralelo é criado.
+ */
+export function useProductFiscalListByIds(
+  productIds: string[],
+  options: { enabled?: boolean } = {},
+) {
+  const request = useProductFiscalAccess("product-fiscal-read");
+  const actor = useProductFiscalAccess("portal-query-actor");
+  const enabled = (options.enabled ?? true) && productIds.length > 0;
+  const result = useScopedPortalQuery<ProductListItem[]>({
+    queryKey: PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.byIds(productIds),
+    enabled,
+    queryFn: async () => {
+      const { data, error } = await (supabase as any)
+        .from("produtos")
+        .select(
+          "id, nome, codigo, familia_catalogo, product_fiscal_profiles(id, profile_status, is_active, ncm, cest, cfop_in_state, cfop_interstate, updated_at)",
+        )
+        .eq("product_fiscal_profiles.is_active", true)
+        .in("id", productIds as any);
+      if (error) {
+        if (isPermissionError(error)) throw new Error("permission_denied");
+        throw new Error(error.message);
+      }
+      return (data ?? []).map((p: any) => {
+        const profileRaw = p.product_fiscal_profiles;
+        const profile = Array.isArray(profileRaw)
+          ? profileRaw[0] ?? null
+          : profileRaw ?? null;
+        return {
+          product_id: p.id,
+          product_nome: p.nome,
+          product_codigo: p.codigo ?? null,
+          profile_id: profile?.id ?? null,
+          profile_status: profile?.profile_status ?? null,
+          is_active: profile?.is_active ?? null,
+          ncm: profile?.ncm ?? null,
+          cest: profile?.cest ?? null,
+          cfop_in_state: profile?.cfop_in_state ?? null,
+          cfop_interstate: profile?.cfop_interstate ?? null,
+          updated_at: profile?.updated_at ?? null,
+          familia: p.familia_catalogo ?? null,
+        };
+      });
+    },
+  }, { request, actor });
+  return { ...result, data: result.ready && !result.isError ? result.data : undefined };
+}

+export function useProductFiscalProfile(
+  productId: string | null,
+  options: { enabled?: boolean } = {},
+) {
+  const request = useProductFiscalAccess("product-fiscal-read");
+  const actor = useProductFiscalAccess("portal-query-actor");
+  const enabled = (options.enabled ?? true) && !!productId;
+  const result = useScopedPortalQuery<ProductFiscalRow | null>({
+    queryKey: [...PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.root, "profile", productId] as const,
+    enabled,
+    queryFn: async () => {
+      if (!productId) throw new Error("product_required");
+      const { data, error } = await (supabase as any)
+        .from("product_fiscal_profiles")
+        .select("*")
+        .eq("product_id", productId)
+        .eq("is_active", true)
+        .maybeSingle();
+      if (error) {
+        if (isPermissionError(error)) throw new Error("permission_denied");
+        throw new Error(error.message);
+      }
+      return data ?? null;
+    },
+  }, { request, actor });
+  return { ...result, data: result.ready && !result.isError ? result.data : undefined };
+}

+export class OptimisticConflictError extends Error {
+  constructor() {
+    super("optimistic_conflict");
+    this.name = "OptimisticConflictError";
+  }
+}
+
+export function useSaveProductFiscalProfile() {
+  const qc = useQueryClient();
+  const fence = useProductFiscalAccess("product-fiscal-save");
+  const actor = useProductFiscalAccess("portal-query-actor");
+  return useMutation<
+    ProductFiscalRow,
+    Error,
+    {
+      productId: string;
+      current: ProductFiscalRow | null;
+      values: ProductFiscalFormValues;
+    }
+  >({
+    mutationFn: async ({ productId, current, values }) => {
+      const valid = fence.capture();
+      const actorValid = actor.capture();
+      const actorScope = actor.scope;
+      const check = () => { if (!valid() || !actorValid()) throw new Error("fiscal_context_changed"); };
+      const invalidate = async () => {
+        check();
+        await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: PRODUCT_FISCAL_KEYS.root,
+          predicate: query => query.queryKey.at(-2) === actorScope });
+        check();
+      };
+      check();
+      if (!fence.canWrite) throw new Error("permission_denied");
+      values = productFiscalFormSchema.parse(values);
+      if (!productId || (current && (current.product_id !== productId || !current.id || !current.updated_at || current.is_active !== true))) throw new Error("fiscal_target_changed");
+      if (!current) {
+        // Verificação prévia: perfil pode existir de outra sessão.
+        const existing = await (supabase as any)
+          .from("product_fiscal_profiles")
+          .select("id")
+          .eq("product_id", productId)
+        .eq("is_active", true)
+          .maybeSingle();
+        check();
+        if (existing.error) {
+          if (isPermissionError(existing.error))
+            throw new Error("permission_denied");
+          throw new Error(existing.error.message);
+        }
+        if (existing.data) {
+          throw new Error("duplicate_profile");
+        }
+        const payload = buildInsertPayload(productId, values);
+        const { data, error } = await (supabase as any)
+          .from("product_fiscal_profiles")
+          .insert(payload as any)
+          .select("*")
+          .single();
+        check();
+        if (error) {
+          if (isPermissionError(error)) throw new Error("permission_denied");
+          throw new Error(error.message);
+        }
+        await invalidate();
+        return data;
+      }
+      const payload = buildUpdatePayload(values, current);
+      if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) {
+        return current; // nada a atualizar
+      }
+      const { data, error } = await (supabase as any)
+        .from("product_fiscal_profiles")
+        .update(payload as any)
+        .eq("is_active", true)
+        .eq("id", current.id)
+        .eq("product_id", current.product_id)
+        .eq("updated_at", current.updated_at)
+        .select("*")
+        .maybeSingle();
+      check();
+      if (error) {
+        if (isPermissionError(error)) throw new Error("permission_denied");
+        throw new Error(error.message);
+      }
+      if (!data) {
+        throw new OptimisticConflictError();
+      }
+      await invalidate();
+      return data;
+    },
+  });
+}

+/**
+ * Perfil fiscal de itens do catálogo PRÓPRIO da empresa (candidato inativo).
+ * Contrato: scripts/fiscal-tenant-catalog-20261101 — RPCs não instalados/sem GRANT.
+ * Empresa vem do servidor (dono imutável do item); nunca enviada pelo cliente.
+ * Dados retornados nunca autorizam nada: o servidor reautoriza toda escrita.
+ */
+export const OWNED_PRODUCT_FISCAL_ENABLED = false as const;
+
+export const OWNED_FISCAL_FIELDS = [
+  "ncm", "cest", "cfop_in_state", "cfop_interstate", "origin_code", "icms_cst", "icms_csosn",
+  "ipi_cst", "pis_cst", "cofins_cst", "commercial_unit", "taxable_unit", "gtin", "taxable_gtin",
+  "tax_benefit_code", "fiscal_description", "accounting_notes",
+] as const;
+export type OwnedFiscalField = (typeof OWNED_FISCAL_FIELDS)[number];
+export type OwnedFiscalValues = Partial<Record<OwnedFiscalField, string | null>>;
+
+const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
+const PATTERNS: Partial<Record<OwnedFiscalField, RegExp>> = {
+  ncm: /^[0-9]{8}$/, cest: /^[0-9]{7}$/, cfop_in_state: /^[1-7][0-9]{3}$/, cfop_interstate: /^[1-7][0-9]{3}$/,
+  origin_code: /^[0-8]$/, gtin: /^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$/, taxable_gtin: /^([0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12,14}|SEM GTIN)$/,
+};
+
+export class OwnedFiscalError extends Error {
+  constructor(public readonly kind: "disabled" | "invalid" | "forbidden" | "conflict" | "uncertain", message: string) {
+    super(message);
+  }
+}
+
+/** Valida/normaliza valores; rejeita chaves fora da lista (ex.: profile_status). */
+export function normalizeOwnedFiscalValues(input: Record<string, unknown>): OwnedFiscalValues {
+  const out: OwnedFiscalValues = {};
+  for (const [k, raw] of Object.entries(input)) {
+    if (!(OWNED_FISCAL_FIELDS as readonly string[]).includes(k)) throw new OwnedFiscalError("invalid", `Campo não permitido: ${k}`);
+    if (raw !== null && typeof raw !== "string") throw new OwnedFiscalError("invalid", `Valor inválido: ${k}`);
+    const v = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.trim() : null;
+    const value = v === "" ? null : v;
+    if (value && value.length > 2000) throw new OwnedFiscalError("invalid", `Valor longo demais: ${k}`);
+    const re = PATTERNS[k as OwnedFiscalField];
+    if (value && re && !re.test(value)) throw new OwnedFiscalError("invalid", `Formato inválido: ${k}`);
+    out[k as OwnedFiscalField] = value;
+  }
+  return out;
+}
+
+export interface OwnedFiscalReceipt {
+  product_id: string; profile_id: string; organization_id: string;
+  profile_status: string; updated_at: string; idempotency_key: string; idempotent: boolean;
+}
+
+/** ACK exato: qualquer divergência é incerta (mantém chave para reconciliação, sem nova tentativa automática). */
+export function parseOwnedFiscalReceipt(data: unknown, expected: { productId: string; idempotencyKey: string }): OwnedFiscalReceipt {
+  const r = data as Record<string, unknown> | null;
+  if (!r || typeof r !== "object" || r.success !== true
+    || r.product_id !== expected.productId || r.idempotency_key !== expected.idempotencyKey
+    || typeof r.profile_id !== "string" || !UUID.test(r.profile_id)
+    || typeof r.organization_id !== "string" || !UUID.test(r.organization_id)
+    || typeof r.profile_status !== "string" || r.profile_status === "VALIDATED"
+    || typeof r.updated_at !== "string" || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(r.updated_at))
+    || typeof r.idempotent !== "boolean") {
+    throw new OwnedFiscalError("uncertain", "Resposta do servidor não confirmada; consulte antes de tentar de novo.");
+  }
+  return r as unknown as OwnedFiscalReceipt;
+}
+
+type RpcClient = { rpc: (fn: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => PromiseLike<{ data: unknown; error: { code?: string; message?: string } | null }> };
+
+export async function saveOwnedProductFiscal(client: RpcClient, input: {
+  productId: string; expectedUpdatedAt: string | null; values: Record<string, unknown>; reason: string; idempotencyKey: string;
+}, enabled: boolean = OWNED_PRODUCT_FISCAL_ENABLED): Promise<OwnedFiscalReceipt> {
+  if (!enabled) throw new OwnedFiscalError("disabled", "Perfil fiscal do catálogo próprio ainda não liberado.");
+  if (!UUID.test(input.productId) || !UUID.test(input.idempotencyKey)) throw new OwnedFiscalError("invalid", "Identificador inválido.");
+  const reason = input.reason.trim();
+  if (reason.length < 10 || reason.length > 500) throw new OwnedFiscalError("invalid", "Informe um motivo de 10 a 500 caracteres.");
+  const values = normalizeOwnedFiscalValues(input.values);
+  const { data, error } = await client.rpc("tenant_owned_product_fiscal_save", {
+    p_product_id: input.productId, p_expected_updated_at: input.expectedUpdatedAt,
+    p_values: values, p_reason: reason, p_idempotency_key: input.idempotencyKey,
+  });
+  if (error) {
+    if (error.code === "42501") throw new OwnedFiscalError("forbidden", "Sem permissão para este item.");
+    if (error.code === "PT409") throw new OwnedFiscalError("conflict", "O perfil mudou ou a chave já foi usada; recarregue antes de salvar.");
+    if (error.code === "22023") throw new OwnedFiscalError("invalid", "Dados fiscais inválidos.");
+    throw new OwnedFiscalError("uncertain", "Não foi possível confirmar a gravação; consulte antes de tentar de novo.");
+  }
+  return parseOwnedFiscalReceipt(data, { productId: input.productId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey });
+}

+          </div>
+          <div>
+            <div className="text-muted-foreground">Microrganismos sem perfil fiscal</div>
+            <div className="font-medium" data-testid="platform-micros-sem-perfil">
+              {microProfilesUnknown ? "—" : microrganismosSemPerfilProprio}
+            </div>
+          </div>
+        </CardContent>
+      </Card>
+      ) : (
+      <Card>
+        <CardHeader>
+          <CardTitle className="text-base">Resumo de prontidão (página atual)</CardTitle>
+          <CardDescription>
+            Produtos e microrganismos listados nesta página e situação dos perfis fiscais próprios.
+          </CardDescription>
+        </CardHeader>
+        <CardContent className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-sm">
+          <div>
+            <div className="text-muted-foreground">Produtos na página</div>
+            <div className="font-medium">{productItems.length}</div>
+          </div>
+          <div>
+            <div className="text-muted-foreground">Microrganismos listados</div>
+            <div className="font-medium">{microItems.length}</div>
+          </div>
+          <div>
+            <div className="text-muted-foreground">Micro com perfil fiscal próprio</div>
+            <div className="font-medium" data-testid="micros-com-perfil-proprio">
+              {microProfilesQuery.data?.length ?? 0}
+            </div>
+          </div>
+          <div>
+            <div className="text-muted-foreground">Micro sem perfil fiscal próprio</div>
+            <div className="font-medium" data-testid="micros-sem-perfil-proprio">
+              {microrganismosSemPerfilProprio}
+            </div>
+          </div>
+        </CardContent>
+      </Card>
+      )}
+
+      {!platformGlobal && <RegulatorioMicrorganismosSecao />}
+
+
+      <Card>
+        <CardHeader className="gap-3">
+          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-3">
+            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 md:flex-1 flex-wrap">
+              <Input
+                placeholder="Buscar por nome, código ou referência"
+                aria-label="Buscar por nome, código ou referência"
+                value={search}
+                onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(0); }}
+                className="max-w-sm"
+              />
+              <Select
+                value={familia ? FAMILY_PREFIX + familia : kind}
+                onValueChange={(v) => {
+                  if (v.startsWith(FAMILY_PREFIX)) { setKind(KIND_PRODUCT); setFamilia(v.slice(FAMILY_PREFIX.length)); }
+                  else { setKind(v as EntityKindFilter); setFamilia(null); }
+                  setPage(0);
+                }}
+              >
+                <SelectTrigger className="max-w-[220px]" aria-label="Filtrar por tipo de item">
+                  <SelectValue placeholder="Tipo" />
+                </SelectTrigger>
+                <SelectContent>
+                  <SelectItem value={KIND_ALL}>Todos</SelectItem>
+                  <SelectItem value={KIND_PRODUCT}>Produtos</SelectItem>
+                  {FAMILY_FILTERS.map((f) => (
+                    <SelectItem key={f.value} value={FAMILY_PREFIX + f.value}>{f.label}</SelectItem>
+                  ))}
+                  <SelectItem value={KIND_MICRO}>Microrganismos</SelectItem>
+                </SelectContent>
+              </Select>
+              <Select
+                value={status ?? STATUS_ALL}
+                onValueChange={(v) => { setStatus(v === STATUS_ALL ? null : v); setPage(0); }}
+              >
+                <SelectTrigger className="max-w-xs" aria-label="Filtrar por status">
+                  <SelectValue placeholder="Todos os status" />
+                </SelectTrigger>
+                <SelectContent>
+                  <SelectItem value={STATUS_ALL}>Todos os status</SelectItem>
+                  {PRODUCT_FISCAL_PROFILE_STATUS_OPTIONS.map((s) => (
+                    <SelectItem key={s.value} value={s.value}>{s.label}</SelectItem>
+                  ))}
+                </SelectContent>
+              </Select>
+            </div>
+          </div>
+        </CardHeader>
+        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
+          {(listQuery.isLoading && kind !== KIND_MICRO)
+            || (microorganismsQuery.isLoading && kind !== KIND_PRODUCT)
+            || (kind !== KIND_MICRO && productIds.length > 0 && readinessQuery.isLoading)
+            || (kind !== KIND_PRODUCT && microIds.length > 0 && microProfilesQuery.isLoading)
+            || (kind !== KIND_PRODUCT && microIds.length > 0 && microReadinessQuery.isLoading) ? (
+            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground" data-testid="fiscal-produtos-loading">
+              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden /> Carregando…
+            </div>
+          ) : listQuery.isError
+            || microorganismsQuery.isError
+            || readinessQuery.isError
+            || microProfilesQuery.isError
+            || microReadinessQuery.isError ? (
+            <Alert variant="destructive" data-testid="fiscal-produtos-error">
+              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden />
+              <AlertTitle>Não foi possível carregar</AlertTitle>
+              <AlertDescription>Tente novamente em instantes.</AlertDescription>
+            </Alert>
+
+          ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
+            <Alert data-testid="fiscal-produtos-empty">
+              <AlertTitle>Nenhum item encontrado</AlertTitle>
+              <AlertDescription>Ajuste a busca ou filtros.</AlertDescription>
+            </Alert>
+          ) : (
+            <>
+              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
+                <table className="w-full text-sm" role="table" aria-label={platformGlobal ? "Perfis fiscais do catálogo global" : "Perfis fiscais de produtos e microrganismos"}>
+                  <thead className="text-left text-muted-foreground">
+                    <tr>
+                      <th className="p-2">Item</th>
+                      <th className="p-2">Tipo</th>
+                      <th className="p-2">NCM</th>
+                      <th className="p-2">CEST</th>
+                      <th className="p-2">CFOP int./inter.</th>
+                      <th className="p-2">Status</th>
+                      <th className="p-2" title="Verificação inicial dos campos essenciais. A revisão contábil e os demais dados fiscais continuam necessários antes da emissão.">Prontidão mínima</th>
+                      <th className="p-2 text-right">Ação</th>
+                    </tr>
+                  </thead>
+                  <tbody>
+                    {rows.map((r) => renderRow(
+                      r,
+                      readinessByProduct,
+                      microReadinessByMicro,
+                      canEditProduct,
+                      canEditMicro,
+                      readinessUnknown,
+                      microProfilesUnknown,
+                      microReadinessUnknown,
+                      (item) => setEditing({
+                        entity: "produto",
+                        productId: item.product_id,
+                        displayName: item.product_nome,
+                        displayCodigo: item.product_codigo ?? null,
+                      }),
+                      (m) => setEditing({
+                        entity: "microrganismo",
+                        microorganismId: m.microorganismId,
+                        displayName: m.microorganismNome,
+                        displayCodigo: m.microorganismCodigo,
+                      }),
+                      (m) => setAssociating({
+                        microorganismId: m.microorganismId,
+                        microorganismNome: m.microorganismNome,
+                        currentProductId: m.linkedProductId,
+                      }),
+                    ))}
+                  </tbody>
+                </table>
+              </div>
+
+              {kind !== KIND_MICRO && (
+                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
+                  <div className="text-muted-foreground">
+                    Página {page + 1} de {totalPages} — {listQuery.data?.total ?? 0} produtos
+                    {kind === KIND_ALL && !familia && microItems.length > 0 && (
+                      <> + {microItems.length} microrganismo(s) na visão unificada</>
+                    )}
+                  </div>
+                  <div className="flex gap-2">
+                    <Button
+                      variant="outline"
+                      size="sm"
+                      disabled={page === 0}
+                      onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1))}
+                    >Anterior</Button>
+                    <Button
+                      variant="outline"
+                      size="sm"
+                      disabled={page + 1 >= totalPages}
+                      onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
+                    >Próxima</Button>
+                  </div>
+                </div>
+              )}
+            </>
+          )}
+        </CardContent>
+      </Card>
+
+      {editing?.entity === "produto" ? (
+        <ProductEditDrawer
+          productId={editing.productId}
+          displayName={editing.displayName}
+          displayCodigo={editing.displayCodigo}
+          canEdit={canEditProduct}
+          onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
+        />
+      ) : null}
+      {editing?.entity === "microrganismo" ? (
+        <MicroorganismEditDrawer
+          microorganismId={editing.microorganismId}
+          displayName={editing.displayName}
+          displayCodigo={editing.displayCodigo}
+          canEdit={canEditMicro}
+          onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
+        />
+      ) : null}
+
+      {TENANT_CAN_EDIT_GLOBAL_CATALOG && associating ? (
+        <AssociateDialog
+          microorganismId={associating.microorganismId}
+          microorganismNome={associating.microorganismNome}
+          currentProductId={associating.currentProductId}
+          onClose={() => setAssociating(null)}
+        />
+      ) : null}
+    </div>
+  );
+}

+// ————————————————————————— Row renderer —————————————————————————
+function renderRow(
+  r: UnifiedRow,
+  readinessByProduct: Map<string, { minimally_classified: boolean | null }>,
+  microReadinessByMicro: Map<string, { minimally_classified: boolean | null; profile_status: string | null }>,
+  canEditProduct: boolean,
+  canEditMicro: boolean,
+  readinessUnknown: boolean,
+  microProfilesUnknown: boolean,
+  microReadinessUnknown: boolean,
+  onEditProduct: (p: ProductListItem) => void,
+  onEditMicro: (m: Extract<UnifiedRow, { kind: "microrganismo" }>) => void,
+  onLinkOptional: (m: Extract<UnifiedRow, { kind: "microrganismo" }>) => void,
+) {
+  if (r.kind === "produto") {
+    const p = r.product;
+    const ready = readinessByProduct.get(p.product_id);
+    const pending = readinessUnknown ? null : !ready?.minimally_classified;
+    return (
+      <tr key={r.rowKey} className="border-t" data-row-kind="produto" data-testid={`row-${r.rowKey}`}>
+        <td className="p-2">
+          <div className="font-medium">{p.product_nome}</div>
+          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.product_codigo ?? "—"}</div>
+        </td>
+        <td className="p-2">
+          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
+            <Badge variant="secondary">{ENTITY_KIND.label("produto")}</Badge>
+            <Badge variant="outline" data-testid="badge-familia">
+              {p.familia ? FAMILY_LABEL[p.familia] ?? p.familia : "Família pendente"}
+            </Badge>
+          </div>
+        </td>
+        <td className="p-2">{p.ncm ?? "—"}</td>
+        <td className="p-2">{p.cest ?? "—"}</td>
+        <td className="p-2">{(p.cfop_in_state ?? "—")}/{(p.cfop_interstate ?? "—")}</td>
+        <td className="p-2">
+          <Badge variant="outline" title={p.profile_status ?? undefined}>
+            {getFiscalStatusLabel("product", p.profile_status)}
+          </Badge>
+        </td>
+        <td className="p-2">
+          {pending === null
+            ? <Badge variant="outline" data-testid="readiness-unknown-badge">—</Badge>
+            : pending
+              ? <Badge variant="destructive" data-testid="pending-badge">Pendente</Badge>
+              : <Badge>OK</Badge>}
+        </td>
+        <td className="p-2 text-right">
+          <Button
+            variant="outline" size="sm"
+            onClick={() => onEditProduct(p)}
+            aria-label={`${canEditProduct ? "Editar" : "Ver"} perfil fiscal de ${p.product_nome}`}
+          >
+            {canEditProduct ? (p.profile_id ? <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />) : "Ver"}
+          </Button>
+        </td>
+      </tr>
+    );
+  }
+  // microrganismo — perfil fiscal PRÓPRIO
+  const own = r.ownProfile;
+  const ownReadiness = microReadinessByMicro.get(r.microorganismId);
+  const ownProfileUnknown = microProfilesUnknown;
+  const pending = !own
+    ? null
+    : microReadinessUnknown
+      ? null
+      : !ownReadiness?.minimally_classified;
+  return (
+    <tr key={r.rowKey} className="border-t" data-row-kind="microrganismo" data-testid={`row-${r.rowKey}`}>
+      <td className="p-2">
+        <div className="font-medium">{r.microorganismNome}</div>
+        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.microorganismCodigo ?? "—"}</div>
+      </td>
+      <td className="p-2">
+        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
+          <Badge variant="secondary">{ENTITY_KIND.label("microrganismo")}</Badge>
+          {r.linkedProductId && (
+            <Badge variant="outline" data-testid="badge-vinculo-opcional" title="Vínculo comercial opcional a produto do catálogo — não interfere no perfil fiscal">
+              Vínculo comercial opcional
+            </Badge>
+          )}
+          {!own && !ownProfileUnknown && (
+            <Badge
+              variant="outline"
+              className="border-amber-500/60 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300"
+              data-testid="badge-perfil-fiscal-pendente"
+            >
+              Perfil fiscal pendente
+            </Badge>
+          )}
+          {ownProfileUnknown && (
+            <Badge variant="outline" data-testid="badge-perfil-desconhecido">
+              Carregando perfil…
+            </Badge>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      </td>
+      <td className="p-2">{own?.ncm ?? "—"}</td>
+      <td className="p-2">{own?.cest ?? "—"}</td>
+      <td className="p-2">
+        {(own?.cfop_in_state ?? "—")}/{(own?.cfop_interstate ?? "—")}
+      </td>
+      <td className="p-2">
+        {own ? (
+          <Badge variant="outline" title={own.profile_status ?? undefined}>
+            {getFiscalStatusLabel("product", own.profile_status)}
+          </Badge>
+        ) : (
+          <Badge variant="outline">—</Badge>
+        )}
+      </td>
+      <td className="p-2">
+        {!own
+          ? <Badge variant="outline">—</Badge>
+          : pending === null
+            ? <Badge variant="outline" data-testid="readiness-unknown-badge">—</Badge>
+            : pending
+              ? <Badge variant="destructive" data-testid="pending-badge">Pendente</Badge>
+              : <Badge>OK</Badge>}
+      </td>
+
+      <td className="p-2 text-right space-x-2">
+        {canEditMicro ? (
+          <>
+            <Button
+              variant={own ? "outline" : "default"}
+              size="sm"
+              onClick={() => onEditMicro(r)}
+              aria-label={`${own ? "Editar" : "Criar"} perfil fiscal de ${r.microorganismNome}`}
+              data-testid="btn-editar-perfil-micro"
+            >
+              {own ? <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" /> : <><Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> Criar perfil fiscal</>}
+            </Button>
+            {/* Vínculo product_id é GLOBAL (migration 20261014192417 revogou a RPC): sem ação para empresa. */}
+            {TENANT_CAN_EDIT_GLOBAL_CATALOG && <Button
+              variant="ghost" size="sm"
+              onClick={() => onLinkOptional(r)}
+              aria-label={`Vínculo opcional a produto — ${r.microorganismNome}`}
+              title="Vínculo comercial opcional a produto do catálogo (não afeta emissão fiscal)"
+              data-testid="btn-vinculo-opcional"
+            >
+              {r.linkedProductId ? <Link2Off className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Link2 className="h-4 w-4" />}
+            </Button>}
+          </>
+        ) : (
+          <Button
+            variant="outline" size="sm"
+            onClick={() => onEditMicro(r)}
+            aria-label={`Ver perfil fiscal de ${r.microorganismNome}`}
+          >
+            Ver
+          </Button>
+        )}
+      </td>
+    </tr>
+  );
+}
+
+// ———————————————————————— Association dialog ————————————————————————
+function AssociateDialog({
+  microorganismId, microorganismNome, currentProductId, onClose,
+}: {
+  microorganismId: string;
+  microorganismNome: string;
+  currentProductId: string | null;
+  onClose: () => void;
+}) {
+  const [pickerSearch, setPickerSearch] = useState("");
+  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(currentProductId);
+  const productsQuery = useProductFiscalList(
+    { search: pickerSearch, status: null, page: 0, pageSize: 50 },
+    { enabled: true },
+  );
+  const associate = useAssociateMicroorganism();
+
+  async function handleAssociate(productId: string | null) {
+    try {
+      await associate.mutateAsync({ microorganismId, productId });
+      toast({
+        title: productId ? "Vínculo comercial atualizado" : "Vínculo comercial removido",
+        description: productId
+          ? "O microrganismo passa a apontar para o produto do catálogo como referência comercial. O perfil fiscal usado no faturamento continua sendo o do próprio microrganismo."
+          : "O vínculo comercial foi removido. Microrganismo, produto e perfis fiscais permanecem intactos.",
+      });
+      onClose();
+    } catch (err) {
+      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
+      if (msg === "permission_denied") {
+        toast({ title: "Sem permissão para alterar o vínculo", variant: "destructive" });
+      } else {
+        toast({ title: "Não foi possível atualizar", description: msg, variant: "destructive" });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(o) => { if (!o) onClose(); }}>
+      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
+        <DialogHeader>
+          <DialogTitle>Vínculo comercial opcional a produto</DialogTitle>
+          <DialogDescription>
+            Vincule <strong>{microorganismNome}</strong> a um produto do catálogo por
+            motivos comerciais ou de composição. <strong>Este vínculo NÃO afeta o
+            faturamento fiscal</strong> — o perfil fiscal do microrganismo continua
+            sendo o próprio.
+          </DialogDescription>
+        </DialogHeader>
+        <div className="space-y-3">
+          <div className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-1.5">
+            <Label htmlFor="picker-search">Buscar produto por nome ou código</Label>
+            <Input
+              id="picker-search"
+              value={pickerSearch}
+              onChange={(e) => setPickerSearch(e.target.value)}
+              placeholder="Digite para filtrar"
+            />
+          </div>
+          <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto border rounded-md" role="listbox" aria-label="Produtos disponíveis">
+            {productsQuery.isLoading ? (
+              <div className="p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
+                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Carregando…
+              </div>
+            ) : (productsQuery.data?.items.length ?? 0) === 0 ? (
+              <div className="p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Nenhum produto encontrado.</div>
+            ) : (
+              <ul className="divide-y">
+                {productsQuery.data!.items.map((p) => {
+                  const isSel = selected === p.product_id;
+                  return (
+                    <li key={p.product_id}>
+                      <button
+                        type="button"
+                        onClick={() => setSelected(p.product_id)}
+                        aria-selected={isSel}
+                        role="option"
+                        className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 hover:bg-accent ${isSel ? "bg-accent" : ""}`}
+                      >
+                        <div className="text-sm font-medium">{p.product_nome}</div>
+                        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.product_codigo ?? "—"}</div>
+                      </button>
+                    </li>
+                  );
+                })}
+              </ul>
+            )}
+          </div>
+        </div>
+        <DialogFooter className="gap-2 flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap">
+          <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>Cancelar</Button>
+          {currentProductId && (
+            <Button
+              type="button" variant="ghost"
+              onClick={() => handleAssociate(null)}
+              disabled={associate.isPending}
+              data-testid="btn-desassociar"
+            >
+              Remover vínculo
+            </Button>
+          )}
+          <Button
+            type="button"
+            onClick={() => selected && handleAssociate(selected)}
+            disabled={!selected || selected === currentProductId || associate.isPending}
+            data-testid="btn-confirmar-associacao"
+          >
+            {associate.isPending ? "Salvando…" : "Confirmar vínculo"}
+          </Button>
+        </DialogFooter>
+      </DialogContent>
+    </Dialog>
+  );
+}
+
+// —————————————————————————— Drawer: produto ——————————————————————————
+function ProductEditDrawer({
+  productId, displayName, displayCodigo, canEdit, onClose,
+}: {
+  productId: string;
+  displayName: string;
+  displayCodigo: string | null;
+  canEdit: boolean;
+  onClose: () => void;
+}) {
+  const profileQuery = useProductFiscalProfile(productId);
+  const save = useSaveProductFiscalProfile();
+  const fence = useProductFiscalAccess(`fiscal-drawer:${productId}`);
+  const submitLock = useRef(false);
+  const readiness = useProductFiscalReadiness([productId]);
+  const preparation = productFiscalPreparation(!fence.ready || readiness.isError || readiness.isFetching ? undefined : readiness.data?.find(r => r.product_id === productId), profileQuery.data?.is_active);
+  const [values, setValues] = useState<ProductFiscalFormValues>(() =>
+    productRowToFormValues(null),
+  );
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setValues(productRowToFormValues(null));
+    setErrors({});
+  }, [fence.scope]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (profileQuery.data !== undefined) {
+      setValues(productRowToFormValues(profileQuery.data));
+    }
+  }, [profileQuery.data]);
+
+  async function onSubmit(ev: React.FormEvent) {
+    ev.preventDefault();
+    if (submitLock.current || !canEdit || !fence.ready || profileQuery.isFetching || profileQuery.isError || profileQuery.data === undefined) return;
+    const valid = fence.capture();
+    setErrors({});
+    const parsed = productFiscalFormSchema.safeParse(values);
+    if (!parsed.success) {
+      const flat: Record<string, string> = {};
+      for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
+        const key = String(issue.path[0] ?? "form");
+        if (!flat[key]) flat[key] = issue.message;
+      }
+      setErrors(flat);
+      toast({ title: "Verifique os campos", variant: "destructive" });
+      return;
+    }
+    try {
+      submitLock.current = true;
+      await save.mutateAsync({
+        productId,
+        current: profileQuery.data ?? null,
+        values: parsed.data,
+      });
+      if (!valid()) return;
+      toast({ title: "Perfil fiscal salvo." });
+      onClose();
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (!valid()) return;
+      if (err instanceof OptimisticConflictError) {
+        toast({
+          title: "Conflito de atualização",
+          description: "Outro usuário alterou este perfil. A versão atual será consultada; revise antes de salvar novamente.",
+          variant: "destructive",
+        });
+        await profileQuery.refetch();
+        return;
+      }
+      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
+      if (msg === "permission_denied") toast({ title: "Sem permissão para salvar", variant: "destructive" });
+      else if (msg === "duplicate_profile") toast({ title: "Perfil já existe", description: "Este produto já possui um perfil fiscal.", variant: "destructive" });
+      else toast({ title: "Não foi possível salvar", variant: "destructive" });
+    } finally {
+      submitLock.current = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <FiscalProfileDrawer
+      title={`${canEdit ? "Editar" : "Detalhes do"} perfil fiscal — produto`}
+      subtitle={`${displayName}${displayCodigo ? ` — ${displayCodigo}` : ""}`}
+      loading={!fence.ready || profileQuery.isLoading || profileQuery.isFetching || profileQuery.isError}
+      saving={save.isPending}
+      canEdit={canEdit && fence.ready && !profileQuery.isFetching && !profileQuery.isError && profileQuery.data !== undefined}
+      values={values}
+      errors={errors}
+      onChange={(k, v) => setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [k]: v }))}
+      onSubmit={onSubmit}
+      onClose={onClose}
+      testId="fiscal-drawer-produto"
+      footer={
+        <div className="mt-6" data-testid="fiscal-produtos-ibs-cbs">
+          <Alert className="mb-4">
+            <AlertTitle>{preparation.stage === "incomplete_draft" ? "Rascunho incompleto" : preparation.stage === "inactive" ? "Perfil inativo" : preparation.stage === "accounting_pending" ? "Revisão contábil pendente" : preparation.stage === "unavailable" ? "Prontidão indisponível" : "Cadastro revisado; operação pendente"}</AlertTitle>
+            <AlertDescription>Salvar um rascunho não torna o item pronto para NF-e. Regime, operação, regras do emitente e IBS/CBS precisam de validação própria; emissão permanece desativada.</AlertDescription>
+          </Alert>
+          {fence.ready && !profileQuery.isFetching && !profileQuery.isError && profileQuery.data !== undefined && (
+            <IbsCbsItemCard kind="product" itemId={productId} canEdit={canEdit && fence.canWrite && profileQuery.data?.is_active === true} />
+          )}
+        </div>
+      }
+    />
+  );
+}

+// ————————————————————— Drawer: microrganismo (perfil próprio) —————————————————————
+function MicroorganismEditDrawer({
+  microorganismId, displayName, displayCodigo, canEdit, onClose,
+}: {
+  microorganismId: string;
+  displayName: string;
+  displayCodigo: string | null;
+  canEdit: boolean;
+  onClose: () => void;
+}) {
+  const profileQuery = useMicroorganismFiscalProfile(microorganismId);
+  const save = useSaveMicroorganismFiscalProfile();
+  const [values, setValues] = useState<MicroorganismFiscalFormValues>(() =>
+    microRowToFormValues(null),
+  );
+  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (profileQuery.data !== undefined) {
+      setValues(microRowToFormValues(profileQuery.data));
+    }
+  }, [profileQuery.data]);
+
+  async function onSubmit(ev: React.FormEvent) {
+    ev.preventDefault();
+    setErrors({});
+    const parsed = microorganismFiscalFormSchema.safeParse(values);
+    if (!parsed.success) {
+      const flat: Record<string, string> = {};
+      for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
+        const key = String(issue.path[0] ?? "form");
+        if (!flat[key]) flat[key] = issue.message;
+      }
+      setErrors(flat);
+      toast({ title: "Verifique os campos", variant: "destructive" });
+      return;
+    }
+    try {
+      await save.mutateAsync({
+        microorganismId,
+        current: profileQuery.data ?? null,
+        values: parsed.data,
+      });
+      toast({ title: "Perfil fiscal do microrganismo salvo." });
+      onClose();
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (err instanceof MicroOptimisticConflictError) {
+        toast({
+          title: "Conflito de atualização",
+          description: "Outro usuário alterou este perfil. Recarregue e tente novamente.",
+          variant: "destructive",
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
+      if (msg === "permission_denied") toast({ title: "Sem permissão para salvar", variant: "destructive" });
+      else if (msg === "duplicate_profile") toast({ title: "Perfil já existe", description: "Este microrganismo já possui um perfil fiscal ativo.", variant: "destructive" });
+      else toast({ title: "Não foi possível salvar", variant: "destructive" });
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <FiscalProfileDrawer
+      title={`${canEdit ? "Editar" : "Detalhes do"} perfil fiscal — microrganismo`}
+      subtitle={`${displayName}${displayCodigo ? ` — ${displayCodigo}` : ""}`}
+      loading={profileQuery.isLoading}
+      saving={save.isPending}
+      canEdit={canEdit}
+      values={values}
+      errors={errors}
+      onChange={(k, v) => setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [k]: v }))}
+      onSubmit={onSubmit}
+      onClose={onClose}
+      testId="fiscal-drawer-microrganismo"
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+// ————————————————————— Drawer genérico compartilhado —————————————————————
+function FiscalProfileDrawer({
+  title, subtitle, loading, saving, canEdit, values, errors,
+  onChange, onSubmit, onClose, testId, footer,
+}: {
+  title: string;
+  subtitle: string;
+  loading: boolean;
+  saving: boolean;
+  canEdit: boolean;
+  values: ProductFiscalFormValues;
+  errors: Record<string, string>;
+  onChange: <K extends FieldKey>(k: K, v: ProductFiscalFormValues[K]) => void;
+  onSubmit: (ev: React.FormEvent) => void;
+  onClose: () => void;
+  testId: string;
+  footer?: React.ReactNode;
+}) {
+  return (
+    <Sheet open onOpenChange={(o) => { if (!o) onClose(); }}>
+      <SheetContent side="right" className="w-full sm:max-w-xl overflow-y-auto" data-testid={testId}>
+        <SheetHeader>
+          <SheetTitle>{title}</SheetTitle>
+          <SheetDescription>{subtitle}</SheetDescription>
+        </SheetHeader>
+
+        {loading ? (
+          <div className="py-6 flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground">
+            <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden /> Carregando…
+          </div>
+        ) : (
+          <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="mt-4 space-y-4" aria-label="Formulário de perfil fiscal">
+            <fieldset disabled={!canEdit || saving} className="space-y-4">
+              {FIELD_ORDER.map((k) => {
+                const raw = values[k] ?? "";
+                const select = FIELD_SELECTS[k];
+                const hint = FIELD_HINTS[k];
+                const placeholder = FIELD_PLACEHOLDERS[k];
+                return (
+                  <div key={k} className="grid min-w-0 content-start gap-1.5">
+                    <Label htmlFor={`f-${k}`}>{FIELD_LABELS[k]}</Label>
+                    {select ? (
+                      <select
+                        id={`f-${k}`}
+                        className="h-10 border rounded-md px-3 bg-background disabled:opacity-60"
+                        value={raw}
+                        onChange={(e) => onChange(k, e.target.value)}
+                        aria-invalid={!!errors[k]}
+                      >
+                        <option value="">— selecione —</option>
+                        {withLegacyOption(select, raw).map((o) => (
+                          <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</option>
+                        ))}
+                      </select>
+                    ) : (
+                      <Input
+                        id={`f-${k}`}
+                        value={raw}
+                        placeholder={placeholder}
+                        onChange={(e) => onChange(k, e.target.value)}
+                        aria-invalid={!!errors[k]}
+                        inputMode={
+                          k === "ncm" || k === "cest" ||
+                          k === "cfop_in_state" || k === "cfop_interstate"
+                            ? "numeric"
+                            : undefined
+                        }
+                      />
+                    )}
+                    {errors[k] ? (
+                      <p className="text-xs text-destructive" role="alert">{errors[k]}</p>
+                    ) : hint ? (
+                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>
+                    ) : null}
+                  </div>
+                );
+              })}
+            </fieldset>
+            <SheetFooter className="mt-4">
+              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
+                {canEdit ? "Cancelar" : "Fechar"}
+              </Button>
+              {canEdit ? (
+                <Button type="submit" disabled={saving}>
+                  {saving ? "Salvando…" : "Salvar"}
+                </Button>
+              ) : null}
+            </SheetFooter>
+          </form>
+        )}
+        {footer}
+      </SheetContent>
+    </Sheet>
+  );
+}

+import { describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";

+  OWNED_PRODUCT_FISCAL_ENABLED, OwnedFiscalError, normalizeOwnedFiscalValues,

+const K = "90000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002";

recarregue antes de salvar.\");\n    if (error.code === \"22023\") throw new OwnedFiscalError(\"invalid\", \"Dados fiscais inválidos.\");\n    throw new OwnedFiscalError(\"uncertain\", \"Não foi possível confirmar a gravação;
